code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated monocytes, eosinophils, and basophils. There is also mild elevation of creatinine and chloride. These findings may indicate bone marrow dysfunction or infiltration, possible chronic hypoxia, and mild renal impairment. Correlation with clinical context and further hematological and renal evaluation are recommended.
